profile.title: Founder & Head Roaster
profile.tagline: Specialty coffee, roasted fresh in Quezon City.
profile.bio: Kalye Kape started as a small street cart in 2021. Today we roast locally grown beans from Benguet and Sagada and serve them in our cozy café in Teachers Village. We also supply fresh beans to offices, restaurants, and events.

contact.address: 123 Maginhawa St., Teachers Village, Quezon City

services.title: Specialty Coffee
services.description: Hand-brewed and espresso drinks from local beans.

services.title: Wholesale Beans
services.description: Freshly roasted beans for cafés and offices.

services.title: Event Coffee Bar
services.description: Mobile coffee bar for weddings and corporate events.

services.title: Barista Workshops
services.description: Weekend classes for beginners and home brewers.

reviews.headline: Enjoyed your coffee?
reviews.message: Your review helps a small local business like ours grow. It only takes 30 seconds — salamat po!

featured.name: Patricia L.
featured.text: Best Spanish latte in Maginhawa! The baristas are super friendly and the place is perfect for working. Fast Wi-Fi too.

featured.name: Carlo M.
featured.text: We booked their coffee bar for our wedding and our guests couldn't stop talking about it. Professional, on time, and the coffee was amazing.

featured.name: Jen R.
featured.text: Cozy café with great pour-over options. It gets busy on weekends, but it's worth the wait.
